reading_issues: Propagation Labs PNG (2523x2526). Measured from native pixels: height axis HS 150 cm at y=355.5 and 0 cm at y=1777 (9.48 px/cm); hardness gridlines K, P, 1f, 4f, F at x=326.5, 632, 937.5, 1243, 1548.5. Layer boundaries come from the table row lines and the connector lines between the hardness chart and the table (thin layers have stretched table rows): 0, 25, 40, 60, 75, 84, 85, 90, 120, 140, 150 cm. The Feb 2 crust bar is only 1 cm thick and its left end is hidden behind the CT17SC label, so its hardness is only bounded below (K- or harder; recorded as K and flagged uncertain). Filled-rectangle glyph read as IF. Grain sizes are blank for every layer except the top PP layer, so size_mm is null. No temperature dots on the chart. The chart header gives surface grain 'Stellars/Dendrites 3.0-5.0mm' while the top layer glyph is '+' with size 2.0-3.0; both recorded (surface_grain PP). The two failure heights sit on layer boundaries (85 cm = top of the crust / base of the 85-90 FC; 40 cm = base of the 40-60 FC / top of the P FCxr), so layer_grain is the softer adjoining layer (FC in both cases) and the weak layer could be either side. Foot Pen and Ski Pen are '?'.
